newsitem.title: USA: Butler Natl says ground broken for casino.
newsitem.headline: Butler Natl says ground broken for casino.

text.p: Butler National Corp said Monday that ground was broken for the STABLES Indian gaming facility in Miami, Okla.
In January, Butler said the National Indian Gaming Commission approved a management contract between the Miami and Medoc tribes of Oklahoma and Butler National Service Corp.
The facility is scheduled to open in September, the company said. Butler, as manager, will receive a 30 percent share of the profits.
